verdict.rationale: Runpod documents multiple official SDKs/APIs for programmatic, AI-native integration: a Serverless SDK for Python/JavaScript/Go, a REST API, a GraphQL API, an official Vercel AI SDK provider (@runpod/ai-sdk-provider) for Public Endpoints, and OpenAI-compatible client library support for vLLM workers, plus CLI and MCP servers for agent integration. This spans direct SDK usage across multiple languages and frameworks, matching an AI-native builder's needs.  missing for 10: independent/hands-on developer corroboration of SDK usability and broader language coverage beyond Python/JS/Go.
